# Jane Example — claim guard

Binding for every resume. SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE.

## Claims not supported
| Claim | Status and reason | Write instead |
|---|---|---|
| Example Portal "350K MAU" (and "350k visitors a month") | Not supported: no export. | 12,345 Google Search clicks (M-01). |
| "post-quantum cryptography" | Not supported: the feature was never shipped. | "encrypted video calls and chat" (1:1). |
| "7+ years of software engineering" | Not supported: production systems date from 2025. | State the real years per area. |
| "Fluent in English" | Not supported. | "English (professional working proficiency)". |

## Metrics not used
| Value | What it measures | Window / date | Source | Strength |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 120 devices, 40 calls | Pilot use | 2026-05-19 | wiki | weak |

## Wording rules
- **Nimbus firewall:** Nimbus is an embeddable chat for marketplaces and never appears with the candidate's name. group calls and burner chats have been off in production.
